'''Aramis Kariya''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Kariya hid near the [[Misty Falls/Legends|Lesser Misty Falls]] region on the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], only to later be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent sent by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FenCorandel.jpg|200px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Aramis Kariya]]
Aramis Kariya was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Aramis Kariya was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:ItDotDS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> As with [[Raphael Mar-Shayal]] and [[Fen Corandel]], Aramis Kariya's appearance was randomly generated.
